name: Michael
overview: Michael is described as one of the chief princes and is identified as a male figure. While his tribe is not specified, he is noted to be an angelic being, indicating a heavenly or spiritual nature rather than a human lineage. His role as a chief prince highlights a position of authority among angelic beings.
namesAndTitles: The name Michael means 'Who is like G-d [El]?' This proper name, found in Daniel 10:13, emphasizes a rhetorical question affirming God's unmatched supremacy. The name itself conveys a challenge to any being who might compare to God, reflecting Michael's role in upholding divine authority.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Michael beyond what is listed in his unique attribute as one of the chief princes. There are no additional familial connections mentioned.
scriptureSignificance: Michael's significance in Scripture stems from his status as a chief prince, suggesting a leadership role among angelic hosts. His identification as an angelic being points to his involvement in spiritual battles or divine missions. The meaning of his name aligns with his function to defend God's honor and authority, marking him as a key figure in the heavenly realm.
